# Ski Haus | Patio Place

> > Family-owned winter sports retailer since 1965 offering ski and snowboard equipment, expert fitting services, and gear from premium brands like Atomic, Nordica, Cotopaxi, and Faction.

Ski Haus operates locations in Salem NH, Framingham MA, and Woburn MA, providing comprehensive ski and snowboard sales, custom boot fitting, tuning services, and trip planning. The Pilla family business also operates under the NOTB and Patio Place brands, expanding into outdoor furniture and lifestyle products.

## Key Topics

- Alpine skiing equipment
- Snowboard gear
- Custom boot fitting
- Ski tuning and maintenance
- Winter sports apparel
- MIPS helmet technology
- System skis for kids
- Swix tuning tools
- Cotopaxi outerwear
- Atomic, Nordica, and Faction skis
- POC protective gear
- Travel and ski bags
- Edge tuning and waxing
- Seasonal sales events
